about_the_game:
Become the Starborn Survivor!

The galaxy is under attack. You are the Starborn Survivor, an ancient robotic warrior, previously known as a Nova Sentinel, armed with forgotten technology, tasked with defending worlds from an alien invasion. In this debut game from our indie team, you’ll face relentless waves of enemies, uncover your mysterious origins, and upgrade your survival abilities.

EARLY ACCESS TITLE

We’re launching Starborn Survivor in Early Access to build the best possible game with the help of our community. As a small, self-funded indie team, we believe that player feedback is essential to refining gameplay, balancing mechanics, and expanding content. Early Access allows us to iterate, experiment, and evolve based on real player experiences, ensuring that every update makes the game more engaging, challenging, and rewarding. Join us in shaping Starborn Survivor!

CHOOSE YOUR PLAYSTYLE

Pick from our first three Cores, each with unique strengths:

  • Defensive: Built to endure, this class excels at absorbing damage and protecting allies.

  • Mobility: Speed and agility define this style, allowing you to outmaneuver and outsmart enemies.

  • Aggressive: Overpower foes with raw firepower and relentless attacks.

Each style brings a different approach to the battlefield, letting you fight your way.

UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL

Start with a basic set of tools, including shields, swords, and launchers!  Expand your capabilities as you play.

  • Collect attachments and upgrades.

  • Earn credits by defeating enemies to unlock more advanced equipment.

  • Experiment with combinations to create a build that suits your style.

DEFEND THE COLONY

The battle takes place on a single colony world, a hostile environment filled with alien threats. Master the terrain, adapt to the challenges, and prepare for intense battles against waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

LEARN, ADAPT, SURVIVE

This is a starting point for what we hope will become an epic universe. While death is inevitable, each failure will teach you more about how to fight, survive, and dominate.

Are you ready to step into the fight and become the Starborn Survivor? The galaxy is counting on you.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: Starborn Survivor is a sci-fi action roguelite where you control a robotic warrior fighting relentless alien hordes. Navigate, shoot, upgrade, and strive to survive for as long as possible! Tailor your loadout and adapt to the increasing challenges in this thrilling bullet-dodging adventure.
